title: IG Reel Day 12 — Suno AI song maker (video-1)

audio.glitchFix: Har TTS segment ke aakhir se 0.40s kaato + 0.1s fade-out + highpass=f=40 (Gemini TTS tail glitch se bachne ke liye)
audio.music: ONE continuous warm pad (single chord, slow attack/release, peak ~0.12) — koi chord change/transition nahi
audio.voice: Gemini TTS (tumhare vault ka GEMINI_API_KEY use karo — spec me explicitly likha hai, allowed hai). Model: gemini-3.8-flash-tts, voice: Tavi, 24kHz/16-bit/mono WAV. Delivery: 'Make Speaker 1 sound excited, cheerful and playful, like a high-energy TV commercial' — natural human, robotic nahi
audio.voiceLanguage: Assamese ONLY — script me koi English token mat bolo (jaise 'suno.com' mat bolo; bolo 'Suno ৱেবছাইট খোলক'). URL screen par text me dikhega.

spec.cameraTechnique: Har scene me DIFFERENT camera movement (slow push-in/static/lateral — repeat mat karo). Scene ke andar hard cuts; gesture ke beech me cut karo (cut on action) taaki cut invisible lage.
spec.ctaRule: Reel ki LAST line hamesha exactly ye hogi (koi next-day teaser nahi): 'সদায় নতুন এ আই টুল পাবলৈ ফল' কৰক'
spec.deliverable: One mp4: day12-suno-reel-v1.mp4. Upload to Storage by Iswar (POST /api/telegram/upload, multipart file + uploadedBy=video-1) and report the fileId.
spec.note: Teeno workers (video-1/2/3) same Day 12 reel bana rahe hain — best quality do, ye comparison hai.
spec.safeArea: Important text/graphics safe zone me rakho: y 250-1480, x 40-930 (IG UI crop karta hai). Zoom max 1.02 ya static.
spec.scriptDraftAssamese:

3. Steps: 'Suno ৱেবছাইট খোলক, কেনেকুৱা গান লাগে লিখক, Generate টিপক — ত্ৰিশ ছেকেণ্ডত গান ৰেডী!'

spec.topic: Day 12 — Suno (suno.com): AI se song/music banao. FREE tier (daily credits). 100 Din 100 AI Websites series, @ai_use_assam
spec.visualStyle: Reel ka look carousel-post jaisa rakho — Suno website/app ke actual screenshots ya AI-generated Suno-interface scenes use karo (simple background par sirf text mat rakho). Narration EXACTLY wahi describe kare jo screen par dikh raha hai.
spec.visualText: On-screen text PURE Assamese script me likho (koi English word text me mat dikhao — URL ko chhodkar). Icons/emoji sirf wahi use karo jo sab devices par sahi render hote hain (widely-supported) — toote hue glyphs/boxes nahi aane chahiye.
